content.text: We need to place orders now. Already placed? No, this is new decision but orders already assigned previous round. Need to assign orders for current round. We have units in pyke (footman, knight), ironmans-bay (ship), port-of-pyke (ship), greywater-watch (footman). We must assign one order to each region with units. We have 0 starred orders allowed (King's Court position for Greyjoy? Check tracks: kingsCourt ["lannister","stark","martell","baratheon","tyrell","greyjoy"] Greyjoy is last position, stars maybe 0). So cannot use starred orders. Must assign regular orders. Preference? Probably want to expand. Maybe march from pyke to ironmans-bay (adjacent) using ship transport? Actually pyke land adjacent to ironmans-bay sea, but footman cannot move via ship transport unless ship present. We have ship in ironmans-bay and port-of-pyke. Could march footman from pyke to ironmans-bay? It's adjacent land/sea? pyke neighbours ironmans-bay (sea) and port-of-pyke (port). Footman cannot move into sea. So need a ship transport: have ship in ironmans-bay, but need ship in a sea area adjacent to pyke? ironmans-bay is sea adjacent to pyke, so footman could use ship transport? rule: footmen can move via ship transport using consecutive sea areas with ships. Here footman in pyke, adjacent sea area ironmans-bay with ship, can move to another coastal area adjacent to that sea area. Could move directly to e.g., seagard? That's not adjacent to ironmans-bay? ironmans-bay neighbours greywater-watch (land), port-of-pyke, pyke, riverrun, seagard, sunset-sea, the-golden-sound. So footman could march from pyke to, say, greywater-watch (land) via ship transport using ship in ironmans-bay. That would be a move and could attack if enemy present. Greywater-watch currently has our footman, so no. Could march to seagard (enemy Lannister area) via ship transport: ironmans-bay has ship, seagard is land adjacent to ironmans-bay. So we could attack seagard. That's a good offensive. Also could use port-of-pyke to defend? Probably place defense on pyke and greywater-watch, and consolidate power on ports? We have ship in port-of-pyke, can consolidate power. Also ironmans-bay ship can consolidate power. So orders: pyke defense, greywater-watch defense, port-of-pyke consolidate_power, ironmans-bay consolidate_power. That's similar to previous round. Might want to use march from pyke? But we need a march order somewhere. We have no march orders assigned currently. Must assign a march to some region with units. Could assign march to pyke (using footman/knight) but cannot move footman into sea. Could march knight from pyke to ironmans-bay? Knight cannot move into sea. So need to assign march on port-of-pyke? Ship cannot march (they can move but march order moves units). March order on port-of-pyke could move ship to adjacent sea area. That could reposition ship for future. Might be better to use march on pyke to move knight to greywater-watch via ship transport? Knight can't move into sea either. So maybe use march on ironmans-bay to move ship elsewhere. But we already have consolidate power there. We have limited orders: each area must have exactly one order. So we need a March order somewhere. Let's choose port-of-pyke with March order (to move ship to ironmans-bay or another sea area). Actually ship already there, but March can move ship to adjacent sea area, like ironmans-bay (already there) or another sea. Might move to greywater-watch's sea? Not needed. Could instead assign march on pyke to move footman via ship transport to seagard attacking. That would be attack. But march order can't allow ship transport? Yes, March order moves units, and ship transport can be used. So assign march on pyke, moving footman (or knight) to seagard (enemy). That would be aggressive. Need a defense elsewhere? Then greywater-watch maybe defense. Ports can have consolidate. Ok assignments: pyke march, greywater-watch defense, port-of-pyke consolidate_power, ironmans-bay consolidate_power. Let's submit.

We need to submit orders. No starred allowed. Four regions must assign orders. Decide objectives: likely expand via march from Pyke to Ironman's Bay (sea?) Actually march moves land only; Ironman's Bay is sea, but you have ship there. Could march from Pyke to Ironman's Bay? No, march moves armies; ships cannot march. Could use raid on neighboring enemy support? Adjacent enemy regions: Pyke neighbours Ironman's Bay and Port of Pyke (both ours). Ironman's Bay neighbours Greywater Watch (our) and Riverrun (enemy). Could raid Riverrun? Raid removes support/raid, not attack. Might want to march from Pyke to Ironman's Bay? Not possible. Could march from Ironman's Bay? No land units there, only ship. Could march from Port of Pyke? No land units. Could march from Greywater Watch (footman) to Ironman's Bay? No, adjacency includes Ironman's Bay (sea) not allowed. So maybe need defense orders to protect our castles. Also consolidate power maybe.

We have 4 units: footman+knight at Pyke, ship at Ironman's Bay, ship at Port of Pyke, footman at Greywater Watch. Need assign orders for each region. Likely defense on Pyke (castle), defense on Greywater Watch (supply). Consolidate power on ports to build tokens. No starred orders.

Set priorities: high priority for defense on Pyke (protect castle). Next defense on Greywater Watch. Consolidate on ports.

Thus assignments:
pyke defense, priority 80, avoid starred.
greywater-watch defense, priority 70.
port-of-pyke consolidate_power, priority 60.
ironmans-bay consolidate_power (maybe also march? but no land), but could ship support? Actually orders apply to region containing units; can assign raid or support or consolidate. Consolidate seems fine to gain power token. priority 50.

Return submit_orders.

We are in bidding phase. Need to submit_bid. Choose amount. We have 8 power tokens. Others have similar. Aim to get Iron Throne? IronThrone track order: baratheon, lannister, stark, martell, greyjoy, tyrell. Greyjoy currently 5th. Want to move up maybe to 4th or higher. Bidding amount determines move up relative to others. Likely need at least 2 to overtake Tyrell? Tyrell has 5 tokens. Greyjoy 8 tokens, already 5th but tokens not directly track? Actually track is order of houses not token count. Bids move house up one spot per token? Usually each bid moves up that many spots? Not sure. Safer: bid moderate 2.
